definitions.explanation: Describes things packed so tightly together that there is no space between them. Emphasizes complete fullness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧みっしり⟦{詰|つ}まっている→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Books are tightly packed on the bookshelf.

examples.japanese: スケジュール⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧みっしり⟦{埋|う}まっている→埋まる：01897_umaru⟧。
⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧みっしりと⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The box is tightly filled with luggage.

notes:
みっしり is an onomatopoeic adverb that emphasizes complete density with no wasted space or gaps. It conveys a sense of things being crammed together so thoroughly that nothing more could fit.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- みっしり⟦{詰|つ}まる→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧: to be packed tightly
- みっしり⟦{埋|う}まる→埋まる：01897_umaru⟧: to be completely filled
- みっしりと⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to be tightly packed inside
- みっしり⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to be lined up densely

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぎっしり→ぎっしり：05891_gisshiri⟧: tightly packed (more common, nearly interchangeable)
- ⟦びっしり→びっしり：05892_bisshiri⟧: densely covered/written (emphasizes surface coverage)
- ⟦ぎゅうぎゅう→ぎゅうぎゅう：05646_gyuugyuu⟧: crammed, squeezed (often for people in tight spaces)
- ⟦すかすか→すかすか：noentry⟧: sparse, with gaps (opposite meaning)

みっしり often takes the particle と (みっしりと) in more formal or written contexts. In casual speech, と is frequently dropped.
